scope: Allow non-null $CEPSNID only when it targets the validated default ACDBPLACEHOLDER under the unique ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME/DICTIONARYWDFLT graph and $CEPSNTYPE is 3.
Include the HEADER reference in named-object-root validation and remap it through the same output handle map as the placeholder graph.
Refuse mismatched, missing, malformed, ambiguous, or unsupported references before destination publication.

source.title: Autodesk DXF HEADER system variables
source.use: $CEPSNTYPE group 380 selects named plot-style behavior (value 3); $CEPSNID group 390 is the corresponding PlotStyleName object handle. This mapping does not establish local native acceptance.

tests: Generated ASCII/Binary source HEADER references target the source default placeholder; strict output readback verifies the remapped CEPSNID equals the emitted placeholder handle.
A CEPSNID changed to a different placeholder target is refused atomically.
A live CEPSNID with CEPSNTYPE 2 is refused atomically.
Standalone HEADER controls retain non-null syntactically valid values and adapter export still refuses when the referenced graph is absent.
validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests lc3_compat_check --parallel 2: PASS (-Werror)

limitations: Only the existing uniquely rooted DICTIONARYWDFLT default-placeholder profile is supported; other PlotStyleName objects remain unimplemented.
No persistent DWG/DXF fixture or full-suite run was added.
No independent producer/native acceptance or support-claim promotion was performed.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; FreeCAD Linux/Windows and independent ACIS/ACDS qualification remain open.
